claim_ceiling: Path B — robustness / sensitivity / decision-reversal / evidence-sufficiency of MODELED comparative pedestrian thermal exposure, with ABSTAIN as a first-class outcome. No accuracy / comfort / behaviour / physiological / health / dose claim.
research_object: Decision reliability + evidence sufficiency + uncertainty + abstention for modeled comparative pedestrian thermal-exposure decisions (Gate-0).

A.identity: Paseo del Prado / Recoletos monumental axis (open, low continuous canopy)

B.identity: Real Jardin Botanico / Retiro western edge + Calle Alfonso XII (tree-lined); park-side (east) sidewalk

routes.note: Both routes continuously walkable, zero REJECT/UNRESOLVED, zero park-gate dependence. Geometry must not change without an amendment.

route_construction.method: corridor-pinned shortest walkable path on the OSM footway/pedestrian graph; NO thermal input

study_day.thermal_field_temporal_resolution: Delta t = 15 min sub-steps across each ~30-40 min trip (primary); static-per-departure-hour fallback lowers the claim explicitly (see GATE2_METRIC_SPEC.md 0.1)
study_day.selection_basis: R1-R7; pre-declared data-quality rule (fully-clear coco=1 + complete 24h + top heat tier 40.0C + max temporal separation from excluded 21 Aug 2023). NOT chosen on route contrast (no thermal output exists).
study_day.R1_heat: AEMET-documented extreme-heat episode 20-25 Aug 2023; Barajas AEMET daily max 40.0 C >= naranja threshold (39 C).
study_day.R2_complete_forcing: Barajas 24/24 hourly, no gaps at target hours.
study_day.R3_sky: coco=1 (Clear) at all daytime hours incl. target hours.
study_day.R5_urban_check: Escuelas Aguirre hourly Ta/RH present and valid at target hours.
study_day.R7_geometry_alignment: 2023 study day aligns with MDS 2023 surface.

model_forcing.solar: pvlib Ineichen clear-sky (recompute for 2023-08-24); applied identically to both routes

independent_urban_check.agreement_with_forcing: Ta within ~0-2 C of Barajas at target hours
independent_urban_check.role: forcing-representativeness check and E-P1 basis; NOT validation of Tmrt/UTCI

regional_context.role: R1 attribution and thresholds; NOT pedestrian validation

bounded_acquisition_extent_epsg25830.note: OD1 clip extent (matches study_area.geojson); all raster clips bounded to this box, NOT city-wide

terrain.source: Madrid MDT 2019 (geoportal.madrid.es), 10 cm COG tiles; IGN MDT 5m in-repo (dem_wcs_5m.tif, sha in gate2_hash_manifest) as cross-check
terrain.bounded_acquisition: select 1km tiles covering the 25830 extent from the geoportal download-mesh shapefile; clip; record clip SHA-256 at execution

normalized_surface_height.source: Madrid MDS 2023 (geoportal.madrid.es dataset id=MDS_2023), 100 pts/m2, 1 m COG tiles
normalized_surface_height.semantics: top-of-everything surface; NOT building/canopy until classified
normalized_surface_height.bounded_acquisition: clip MDS 2023 + MDT 2019 tiles covering the 25830 extent; nSH=MDS-MDT; record clip SHA-256 at execution; NOT city-wide

building_classification.reproducible_query: https://ovc.catastro.meh.es/INSPIRE/wfsBU.aspx?service=WFS&version=2.0.0&request=GetFeature&typenames=bu-ext2d:Building&srsname=urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::4326&bbox=<OD1 in 4326>,urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::4326 ; reproject to 25830; record GetFeature response SHA-256 at execution
building_classification.height_rule: building height = nSH within footprint; Catastro numberOfFloorsAboveGround REJECTED as height (floor-count proxy, frequently nil=unpopulated per audit)

vegetation_classification.strategy: canopy = nSH masked to vegetation; mask = union(municipal tree-inventory buffers, OSM green polygons, Copernicus TCD>=threshold)
vegetation_classification.tree_inventory: datos.madrid.es 300761 (in-repo live geojson); 1322 park + 1528 street trees in-corridor; species + ALTURA height; NOT crown polygons
vegetation_classification.prohibitions: no crown geometry from points; no historical crown; Sentinel-2/optical NEVER as thermal/LST
vegetation_classification.status: bounded uncertainty compatible with Path B; ABSTAIN if canopy state flips A-vs-B ordering (E-P2/NC7)

wind_treatment.decision: UNIFORM station wind only (single non-local point applied to whole grid)
wind_treatment.observation: Barajas wind at target hours (11.2 / 6.0 km/h); Escuelas Aguirre does NOT measure wind; only 6 peripheral municipal met stations measure wind/radiation, none in corridor
wind_treatment.spatial_wind: E-P3 DEMOTED; no justified canyon multiplier; URock NOT introduced; spatial heterogeneity is an unresolved limitation / ABSTAIN trigger if shown decision-critical
wind_treatment.acceptability_under_PathB: acceptable: low target-hour wind (1.7-3.1 m/s) reduces canyon-channeling magnitude; applied identically to both routes; claim ceiling forbids a spatial-wind claim anyway

metrics: M5 max/95th percentile (DESCRIPTOR ONLY, not decision-bearing)
outcome_metrics.intensity_vs_duration_decomposition: THERMAL-INTENSITY {M2,M3,M5} (length-independent) reported SEPARATELY from EXPOSURE-DURATION {M1,M4} (length-dependent); shorter route != cooler microclimate; intensity/duration trade-off -> NO ROBUST DIFFERENCE/ABSTAIN; NO composite score
outcome_metrics.removed: cumulative integral (INT UTCI dt) — removed at Gate 1; no output called dose
outcome_metrics.spatial_sampling: Delta s = 5 m along-route; buffer-mean per locked-pilot validated choice; >5% missing pixels -> ABSTAIN
outcome_metrics.temporal_sampling: departure-time, time-resolved: Delta t = 15 min SOLWEIG fields; segment timestamp t_k = departure + cumulative_distance/v; UTCI sampled from nearest-t_k field; hourly met linearly interpolated; clear-sky GHI recomputed per timestamp; identical for both routes; static-per-hour fallback = explicit claim-lowering downgrade
outcome_metrics.UTCI_categories_source: Broede et al. 2012 Int J Biometeorol 56:481-494 / www.utci.org; heat cut-points +26/+32/+38/+46 C
outcome_metrics.UTCI_category_semantics: sample-by-sample category accounting (M4) is the boundary-meaningful metric; categorising a route-AVERAGE (M2) is a descriptive band only, NOT a physiological classification of the journey (Path B)

perturbations.E-P1_forcing: Barajas as-is vs empirical hourly Escuelas-Aguirre-minus-Barajas Ta/RH (measured: dTa -1.7..+0.1 C, dRH +3..+6%)
perturbations.E-P2_canopy: PNOA nDSM 2008-2015 vs MDS2023 nSH masked-to-veg vs tree-inventory presence audit vs Copernicus TCD 2018 (dominant; NC7 ABSTAIN if ordering flips)
perturbations.E-P4_building: MDS2023-MDT2019 nSH classified via Catastro footprints vs PNOA 2008-2015 building nDSM
perturbations.E-P5_side_of_street: frozen sidewalk vs opposite sidewalk (Route A Prado central promenade vs west sidewalk; Route B east/park-side vs west sidewalk of Alfonso XII)
perturbations.E-P6_speed: 1.1 vs 1.4 m/s; optional identical endpoint pause
perturbations.boundary_guard: category metric clear iff perturbation-ensemble interval excludes cut-points +26/+32/+38/+46 C; no invented fixed guard

negative_controls: docs/research/pedestrian-heat/gate2/GATE2_EVIDENCE_REPORT.md §2I (NC1-NC7 operationalised with explicit ABSTAIN evidence conditions, pre-declared before any thermal output)
prohibitions_restated: 21 Aug 2023 not used as independent validation of the locked HATI output; 24 Aug 2023 is a NEW day reusing NO locked thermal/asset result
no Sentinel-2/optical as thermal or LST
no ERA5-Land / same-forcing / another-model-run treated as independent pedestrian UTCI validation
no invented material-UTCI-difference threshold; decision-stability formalism governs
